issue.title: System Phase1-3 P-A: Knowledge typed delivery and fixed-byte binding engineering assignment

acceptance_criteria.verbatim: 現行Knowledge input/handoffがHandoffv2予約型検出と衝突し配送不可な問題を解消。ArtifactDeliveryの明示minor version(推奨1.1)でknowledge-input-v1/knowledge-handoff-v1/knowledge-context-v1を導入。旧Delivery1.0/旧Handoff2.0/Knowledge1.0/Readiness1.0の意味・既存正常系を維持。
format/version/document_type/identity dispatchを厳格検証。genericJSON/text/Handoffへの降格偽装、未知/欠損/重複型、private_only、JSON重複/NaN/BOM/切詰め、path/URL/symlink/gitlink等既存防御を維持。

Knowledgeinput↔handoff間assignment/raw_findings/knowledge_references/task_id/attempt/retry_ofの一致、全findingの判断、adopted記事実体、source/context/articleの固定bytes/digest/locatorを機械照合。自由locatorだけを存在証明とせず全必要実体をbundleに含めfailclosed。既存schemaに無断追加fieldを押し込まない。引用された内容をAgentへの命令にしない。
manifest/publication/consumption/authorization schema版とCLI・docs・samplesを整合。承認scope/consumer/purpose/pinとreceiptの無権限性維持。旧版で新formatを静かに通さない。Readiness成功やIssueACに波及しない。
正常/異常回帰tests、旧107tests全成功、実固定GitのKnowledgefixture配送を独立Testが再現できる手順。データは公開済みexamplesまたは明示synthetic。Test/Reviewは別CloudでManager起動。
公開安全なコード/契約/文書/fixturesのDraftPR、固定head/CI/消費receipt/完全Handoff/検証証跡を出す。実運用非同期/周期成功はP-B/C/D未実施として残す。

summary: Independent P-A Review PASS at fixed head; no blocking finding. Reproduced 128 head/107 base methods, Test 117 probes, 45 checkout checks, and 32 Review cases. Merge Ready blocked, Issue2 Completion unverified. Public alias is not a runtime identity.

evidence.claim: Assigned independent review complete at pinned revision with reproducible evidence and explicit limits.
evidence.observation: All recorded reproduction expectations matched. Review code and CI separately; GitHub policy access limits and no merge authority retained.

ac_mapping.scope: Delivery 1.1 explicit three-format dispatch fixes the prior Knowledge input/handoff collision. Ten legacy schemas and seven existing test files are byte-identical; 107 base and 128 head tests pass. Delivery 1.0 generic context retains only its legacy guarantee.

Reviewed strict parse and discriminator/schema checks, incomplete/unknown identity reservation, private_only, version/format downgrade, duplicate fields, BOM/nonfinite literals/truncation, path/Git mode and raw-byte defenses. Regressions and independent mutations fail closed.

Input/result binding compares all six immutable fields. Each typed input/result has exactly one binding; task identity duplicates reject. All declared source/article/artifact/retry dependencies are resolved in the owning repository/commit with raw digest. All findings have supported decisions; adopted articles require nonempty text. Tuple-key probes establish snapshot isolation, including missing/conflicting counterpart sources.

Four delivery record versions and schemas agree; legacy new-format rejection retained. Authorization exact pin/consumer/scope/purpose/expiry/representation precedes acquisition. Fabricated receipts and altered pins reject; receipts retain authority_granted=false. No approval or Readiness success is inferred.

Reproduced 128 head, 107 base, Test 111 in-memory + 6 CLI cases, 45 checkout checks, 32 Review-owned cases and fresh fixed-Git six-file preparation/consume/recheck. Review and Test provenance are separate per Manager dispatch; no recursive specialist launch.

PR4 draft/open at exact head/base. Both CI runs succeed; PR CI actual merge checkout and same head tree verified. Complete local public-alias Handoff and evidence sealed, no publication or merge. P-B/C/D remain unimplemented.

completion_criteria: Independently review all supplied PA-1 through PA-6 at fixed head/base after authorized whole-bundle consumption.
Critically reproduce tests and adversarial failures; return findings with location/reproduction/severity/remediation if any, without implementation changes.
Return Handoff v2, review report, reproduction results, verified Consumption Receipt, and current Merge Readiness observations/unknowns separately from product Issue2 Completion.
Preserve originals and present safe public-alias candidate sizes/hashes to Manager; do not publish.
